title: Data Engineer, Specialist
description:
Provides expert level data solutions by using software to process, store, and serve data to others. Tests data quality and optimizes data availability. Ensures that data pipelines are scalable, repeatable, and secure. Utilizes the deepest dive analytical skillset on a variety of internal and external data. Leads, instructs, and mentors newer Data Engineering crew.
  
  
**About Vanguard**
Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
  
  
**Vanguard India**
Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Data Engineer, Senior Specialist is responsible for designing, developing and optimizing data pipelines and architectures to support scalable and efficient data processing. This role involves working with complex datasets, integrating multiple data sources and ensuring high data quality and reliability. The role requires a strong product mindset to understand business needs, translate them into sustainable technical solutions, and take end-to-end ownership of delivery, quality, reliability, and continuous improvement. The individual will collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to deliver secure, high-quality, and future-ready data solutions while contributing to modern AI-assisted engineering practices.
  
  
The role also carries technical ownership for business-critical data products and platforms, including production reliability, incident management, release support, operational improvements, and sustainable application-support practices.
  
  
**Responsibilites**

* Develop and maintain efficient ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) pipelines that ingest, process and transform large datasets from diverse sources. Build and manage data storage solutions using relational and non-relational databases, ensuring high availability, performance and scalability.
* Work with APIs, third-party data sources and internal databases to create unified datasets that provide actionable insights for business stakeholders.
* Partner with business intelligence analysts, data scientists and software engineers to design and implement data-driven solutions that meet business requirements.
* Design optimized data schemas and structures that support analytical workloads and improve query performance.
* Leverage orchestration tools like Apache Airflow or Prefect to automate ETL workflows and improve operational efficiency.
* Provide technical guidance, review code and promote best practices within the data engineering team.
* Lead and mentor Data and AI Engineers, providing technical direction, coaching, and engineering guidance.
* Lead solution architecture and technical design, ensuring alignment with business objectives, product priorities, and engineering standards.
* Design and optimize scalable data pipelines, cloud data platforms, data models, and storage solutions supporting analytical and operational workloads.
* Architect reliable batch and real-time data processing solutions, incorporating data quality, governance, security, performance, and scalability.
* Partner with Product Owners, business stakeholders, Architects, Analysts, and Engineering teams to translate requirements into sustainable data solutions.
* Take end-to-end technical ownership across design, development, deployment, production reliability, and continuous improvement.
* Evaluate technical options and make informed architecture decisions considering performance, scalability, security, cost, reliability, and maintainability.
* Establish engineering and operational practices covering CI/CD, automation, testing, observability, monitoring, release readiness, and production support.
* Lead complex production incident resolution, root-cause analysis, preventive actions, and reliability improvements, while guiding engineers in troubleshooting and reducing operational risk.
* Drive engineering excellence through architecture/design/code reviews, reusable patterns, DevOps practices, and AI-assisted development.
* Strong product mindset, connecting technical decisions and engineering investments to business and customer outcomes.
* Proven ability to lead, mentor, and influence engineers while remaining technically hands-on.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, troubleshooting, and technical decision-making skills.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management across technical, business, and product teams.
* Ability to navigate ambiguity, balance competing priorities, and proactively manage risks, dependencies, and trade-offs.
* Strong commitment to engineering excellence, operational reliability, and continuous improvement.
* Willingness to provide technical leadership during critical production incidents, major releases, and business-critical situations outside regular working hours when required.

* Minimum 8 years of relevant work experience, with at least 4 years focused on designing and developing scalable data pipelines, ETL frameworks and database management systems.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Computer Science or IT, or Bachelor’s in Computer Applications (BCA) from a recognized institution.
* Proficiency in SQL and database technologies such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, or SQL Server.
* Hands-on experience with big data frameworks like Apache Spark, Hadoop, or Databricks.
* Strong programming skills in Python, Scala, or Java for data processing and automation.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, particularly in data services like AWS Glue, Redshift, Big Query, or Snowflake.
* Deep hands-on experience architecting and delivering AWS-based data solutions using services such as S3, Glue, Lambda, Redshift, Athena, Step Functions, SNS/SQS, IAM, CloudWatch, Kinesis, and EMR. Ability to make architecture decisions covering scale, security, reliability, performance, and cost.
* Hands-on experience or strong working knowledge of Amazon Bedrock, including Knowledge Bases, Guardrails and Agents, along with SageMaker, Lambda, S3, OpenSearch Serverless vector capabilities, Step Functions, and infrastructure as code using CDK or CloudFormation.

title: Data Analyst, data engineers, data specialist
description:
About the role

We are hiring a Senior Azure Databricks Data Engineer to design, build and own an enterprise lakehouse on Azure Databricks — from the first workspace to production-grade Bronze, Silver and Gold layers. You have built a Medallion architecture from the ground up, not just worked inside one. You know how to set up the platform so it scales, performs well and stays cost-efficient, with governance, security and data quality built in from day one.

Key responsibilities

Medallion architecture (Bronze / Silver / Gold)

* Design and build the Medallion lakehouse from scratch on Azure Databricks and Delta Lake.
* Define layer contracts: raw, append-only ingestion in Bronze; cleansed, conformed and deduplicated data in Silver; business-ready, modelled data (star schemas, data marts, aggregates) in Gold.
* Build batch and streaming ingestion with Auto Loader, Structured Streaming, Delta Live Tables (Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines) and Azure Data Factory.
* Implement incremental processing, CDC, SCD Type 1/2, MERGE patterns, schema evolution and late-arriving data handling.
* Set data quality rules and expectations at each layer, with quarantine and alerting for bad records.

Platform architecture and scalability

* Architect the Azure Databricks environment: workspaces, dev/test/prod separation, VNet injection, Private Link, ADLS Gen2 storage layout and naming standards.
* Design for scale across data volume, number of pipelines, teams and concurrent users.
* Define cluster policies, compute types (job, all-purpose, serverless, SQL warehouses) and orchestration with Databricks Workflows.
* Build reusable frameworks: metadata-driven ingestion, common libraries, templates and logging.

Performance optimisation

* Tune Spark and Delta workloads: partitioning, liquid clustering, Z-ORDER, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, file sizing, caching, AQE and Photon.
* Diagnose and fix skew, shuffle, spill and small-file problems using the Spark UI and query profiles.
* Set and meet SLAs for pipeline run time and data freshness.

Cost optimisation (FinOps)

* Right-size clusters, use autoscaling, auto-termination, spot instances and serverless where it lowers cost.
* Enforce cost controls through cluster policies, tagging and budgets.
* Track DBU and Azure spend with system tables and dashboards, and report savings.

Governance, security and standards

* Implement Unity Catalog: metastore, catalogs/schemas per layer and domain, external locations, storage credentials.
* Set up role-based access, row- and column-level security, data masking and PII handling.
* Enable lineage, auditing, data classification and integration with Microsoft Purview.
* Manage secrets with Azure Key Vault and identities with Entra ID service principals and managed identities.
* Define and document engineering standards: coding guidelines, naming conventions, review process and data contracts.

DevOps and delivery

* Build CI/CD with Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions and Databricks Asset Bundles.
* Provision infrastructure as code with Terraform or Bicep.
* Add unit and integration tests, monitoring and alerting for pipelines.

Leadership

* Act as technical lead: mentor engineers, review code and design, and set best practices.
* Work with architects, analysts, data scientists and business stakeholders to turn requirements into data products.

Required skills and experience

* 7+ years in data engineering, including 3+ years building production workloads on Azure Databricks.
* Proven track record of building a Medallion architecture from the ground up — be ready to walk through one you designed end to end.
* Expert in PySpark and Spark SQL; strong Python and SQL.
* Deep knowledge of Delta Lake: ACID transactions, time travel, MERGE, CDF, OPTIMIZE, liquid clustering.
* Hands-on with Unity Catalog and data governance: access control, lineage, auditing, PII protection.
* Strong Azure stack: ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory, Key Vault, Entra ID, Event Hubs, Azure Monitor, networking basics (VNet, Private Endpoints).
* Proven results in Spark performance tuning and cloud cost optimisation, with numbers to show for it.
* Data modelling: dimensional modelling (Kimball), Data Vault awareness, SCD patterns.
* CI/CD and IaC: Git, Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, Databricks Asset Bundles, Terraform.
* Clear communicator who can explain design trade-offs to both engineers and business stakeholders.

Nice to have

* Certifications: Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional, Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203) or Fabric Data Engineer (DP-700), Databricks Lakehouse Platform Architect.
* Experience migrating from on-prem (SQL Server, Hadoop, Informatica, SSIS) or Synapse to Databricks.
* Databricks SQL, Lakehouse Monitoring, MLflow or Feature Store exposure.
* dbt on Databricks, Great Expectations, or similar data quality tools.
* Power BI integration and semantic model design on Gold data.
* Experience with data mesh or domain-oriented data products.

title: OPEX Executive – Process Improvement, AI & Automation
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a proactive, tech-savvy OPEX Executive who can identify operational inefficiencies, improve business processes and build technology-driven solutions that help our company operate more efficiently.

You will work closely with leadership and different departments to understand how work gets done, identify where time and resources are being wasted, and implement practical solutions using AI, automation and internal tools.

This could involve evaluating a department's workflow to reduce unnecessary manual work, building an internal training academy using existing SOPs, developing dashboards to track performance, or automating repetitive reporting tasks.

We are looking for someone who can take a business problem statement, determine the best way to solve it, and turn it into a working solution quickly. For smaller projects, the expectation is to develop a functional first version within 24–48 hours where the scope permits, then test and improve it based on feedback.

**This is a hands-on implementation role. You will be expected to identify problems, build solutions, implement improvements and measure the results — not simply prepare reports or make recommendations.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Business Process Improvement & Time Efficiency**

* Evaluate existing company processes across departments to identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, duplicated work and unnecessary manual tasks.
* Conduct time-and-motion analysis to understand how long tasks take, where time is being lost and how workflows can be improved.
* Map existing workflows and identify opportunities to simplify processes, reduce steps and improve turnaround times.
* Work with department heads and team members to understand operational challenges and identify practical improvements.
* Develop and implement solutions that reduce administrative workload, repetitive tasks and dependency on manual follow-ups.
* Measure the impact of improvements by tracking time saved, productivity, error reduction and process turnaround times.
* Continuously review existing workflows and recommend improvements as the business grows.

**2. AI-Powered Internal Tools & Systems**

* Translate business problem statements into functional internal tools, platforms and systems.
* Build tools such as internal training academies, knowledge hubs, SOP libraries, onboarding portals and operational management systems.
* Use existing company documentation, SOPs and resources to create structured, searchable and user-friendly internal platforms.
* Use AI tools to accelerate development and turn ideas into functional prototypes quickly.
* Test solutions with end users, incorporate feedback and improve usability.
* Take ownership of tools from initial concept through implementation, maintenance and ongoing improvement.

**3. Internal Dashboards & Backend Development**

* Build and maintain internal dashboards for departmental KPIs, business performance, team productivity and operational tracking.
* Develop the underlying data structures, workflows, logic and integrations required to make dashboards functional.
* Connect relevant data sources and internal tools to reduce manual reporting and improve data visibility.
* Update dashboards and systems as business requirements evolve.
* Ensure tools are accurate, reliable, easy to use and appropriately access-controlled.

**4. AI, Prompt Engineering & Rapid Prototyping**

* Use AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT and AI-assisted coding platforms to build, troubleshoot and improve internal solutions.
* Write effective prompts and structured instructions to develop functional tools and automate processes.
* Identify the most appropriate combination of AI tools, no-code platforms, integrations and coding for each problem.
* Experiment with new technologies to find faster and more effective ways of working.
* Validate AI-generated outputs, troubleshoot errors and ensure solutions work as intended.
* Stay informed about emerging AI capabilities and identify opportunities to apply them across the business.

**5. Workflow Automation & System Integration**

* Identify repetitive tasks and manual workflows that can be automated.
* Build automations connecting internal systems, forms, databases, dashboards and reporting tools.
* Reduce manual data entry, duplicated work and unnecessary communication between departments.
* Improve information flow, accountability and visibility across teams.
* Document automated workflows and maintain clear instructions for ongoing use.

**6. System Maintenance & Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain and improve existing dashboards, internal tools, automations and workflows.
* Respond to changing business requirements and implement updates promptly.
* Troubleshoot issues, resolve errors and maintain data accuracy.
* Update SOPs and process documentation whenever workflows change.
* Monitor whether implemented solutions are delivering the intended results.
* Take ownership of the systems you build instead of relying on external developers for routine changes.

**Skills & Experience**

* 2–4 years of experience in operations, process improvement, business systems, automation, internal tool development or a related field.
* Demonstrable experience building functional dashboards, internal tools, web applications or automated workflows.
* Practical experience using AI tools to develop and improve digital solutions.
* Ability to translate ambiguous business requirements into structured solutions and working prototypes.
* Understanding of workflow mapping, process optimisation, root-cause analysis or time-and-motion analysis.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted coding, no-code/low-code development or frontend development.
* Understanding of APIs, webhooks, databases, data structures and system integrations.
* Experience with tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, ClickUp, Google Sheets, GoHighLevel, n8n, Make or similar platforms.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to learn unfamiliar technologies quickly and work independently.
* Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate with different departments.
* Understanding of data security, access permissions, testing and system reliability.
* **Travel:**
  Must be comfortable travelling between Delhi and Gurgaon as required.

Candidates do not need expertise in every tool listed. We value practical building ability, analytical thinking, initiative and speed of execution over familiarity with a specific technology stack.

**The Ideal Candidate**

You are someone who:

* **Thinks in solutions:**
  You can take a business problem and determine how best to solve it.
* **Identifies inefficiencies:**
  You naturally question why a process exists, how long it takes and whether it could be done better.
* **Builds quickly:**
  You can develop a functional first version within hours or days rather than spending weeks planning.
* **Uses AI effectively:**
  You know how to prompt, build, debug and refine solutions using AI tools.
* **Understands systems:**
  You can work with dashboards, data, workflows, integrations and internal processes.
* **Takes ownership:**
  You implement solutions rather than stopping at recommendations.
* **Measures outcomes:**
  You look for tangible improvements in time, effort, accuracy and productivity.
* **Works independently:**
  You need the desired outcome explained, not every individual step prescribed.
* **Adapts quickly:**
  You are comfortable with changing priorities and evolving business requirements.

**What Success Looks Like**

Within your first 90 days, you should be able to:

* Evaluate processes across multiple departments and identify high-impact improvement opportunities.
* Implement practical solutions that reduce manual work, wasted time and operational bottlenecks.
* Build and deploy internal dashboards and tools from business problem statements.
* Develop and improve internal platforms using existing company SOPs and resources.
* Automate repetitive workflows and reduce dependency on manual reporting.
* Demonstrate measurable improvements in time efficiency, turnaround times and team productivity.
* Establish a continuous improvement process for reviewing, optimising and documenting business operations.

**How to Apply**

Please share your CV and examples of dashboards, internal tools, automations or process improvements you have worked on.

As part of your application, briefly explain:

1. What business or operational problem were you solving?
2. What did you personally build or improve?
3. Which tools and technologies did you use?
4. How long did it take to implement?
5. What measurable results did the solution achieve?

Practical demonstrations and working examples will be valued more highly than certifications alone.

title: SLIMS Technical Consultant
description:
**Job Description**
Agilent inspires and supports discoveries that advance the quality of life. We provide life science, diagnostic, and applied market laboratories worldwide with instruments, services, consumables, applications, and expertise. Agilent enables customers to gain the answers and insights they seek - so they can do what they do best: improve the world around us. Information about Agilent is available at www.agilent.com.
  
  
**OpenLab Sync (formerly SLIMS)**
is a platform that allows supervision of all stages a sample follows to the result.
**OpenLab Sync**
captures information about the sample, requests for measurements, and follows its entire workflow through the lab, supervising manual operating procedures, automated instrument steps, and calculations until the final report.
  
  
If you decide to join our team, you will be working closely with our clients. The tasks to be performed are multifaceted, and a creative mind is needed to be able to identify and implement customer solutions and improve the quality of life in the lab environment. Want to learn more about OpenLab Sync? Visit OpenLab Sync for more information and even some videos.
  
  
This role is ideal for candidates who combine hands-on laboratory experience with technical software implementation skills. Successful candidates typically have experience working in laboratory informatics, scientific software, LIMS, ELN, LES, or laboratory automation environments.
  
  
As an
**Application Engineer**
part of the Customer Success team in India, you will support our valued customers across our Lab informatics product solutions. This role offers you the opportunity to travel and explore a variety of labs, so it is vital to have an appetite for continuously learning about new software technology, instruments, applications, and consumables. In addition, applying communication skills, creativity, and a can-do approach is vital.
  
  
**Your main responsibilities will be:**

* Analyze customers' needs and translate them into OpenLab Sync workflows
* Configure the OpenLab Sync platform to match the lab's requirements
* Build plugins for connecting instruments or displaying custom forms or portals
* Act as the customer voice to influence future product design to meet customer needs
* Script a lab's in-silico tools into our integration framework

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who has a keen interest in Lab Informatics and is seeking a new challenge. A curious individual who is driven to learn and has the desire to understand and solve customer problems to deliver customer success will succeed in this position.
  
  
**Qualifications**
We are looking for motivated individuals with the following background:
  
  

* University Degree in Life Sciences, Bioinformatics, Biotechnology, Chemistry, Computer Science, Scientific Informatics, or a related discipline (or alternatively solid relevant experience in this application engineering field)
* Hands-on laboratory experience in analytical chemistry, biobanks, pharma, biopharma, genomics, NGS, Academia, etc.
* Preferred experience with LIMS, ELN, LES, SDMS, CDS, laboratory automation, scientific software, or laboratory workflow management systems.
* You have knowledge of programming languages such as Java or Python with proven coding skills
* Experience working directly with customers, stakeholders, laboratory users, or cross-functional project teams is highly desirable.
* Full proficiency in English.

On a personal level, you possess great
**problem solving**
/
**analytical skills, and**
you are
**eager to learn**
about new software technology, instruments, applications, and consumables. You have
**communication/interpersonal skills**
to interact at various levels, and you strive to provide excellent customer support. You enjoy both
**working within a team**
and
**autonomously**
.
  
  
We will make sure
**you get all the training and development opportunities you need to become the best in your field!**
**Additional Details**
This job has a full time weekly schedule.
  
  
Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
